chapter_title: The Apostle asks his Disciples: What is Cloud?
chapter_note: This chapter is dominated by the oldest teaching layer — a systematic five-fold cloud teaching mapping each light element (fire, water, wind, light, mingled air) to cloud type, atmospheric sign, ruler behavior, and angelic response. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system. The structure is highly regular: for each element, the pattern is cloud-ascent → Virgin's likeness → sign → purification of lives → ruler release → destruction → angelic seizure. Editorial material is confined to the opening scene-setting (¶1), a brief dialogue exchange (¶14-15 frames), and the devotional closing (¶18). Paragraph 17 is a first-person recap with one distinctive cosmological datum (the Virgin's authority over the zone). Despite extensive lacunae, the five-fold structure is clearly preserved. Gardner notes the prominence of the Virgin of Light's authority here, a role elsewhere assigned to the Third Ambassador.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Narrative scene-setting: 'the apostle is sitting in the congregation of his disciples,' visual narration ('heavens were cloudy'), first-person promise ('I will reveal and teach you'). The teaching topic ('how it ascended') is embedded in pure frame narrative. The 'congregation' language may account for the institutional vocabulary score.

paragraphs.core_text: it shall be released from five places and ascend over this great earth and [ ... ] and it is revealed and seen in the atmosphere between.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'Happen you know that' — pedagogical address formula (dialogue frame layer).
paragraphs.temporal_note: This paragraph establishes the five-fold structure of the teaching. 'Five places' is the systematic enumeration key. 'Atmosphere between' is cosmic geography. High dialogue_frame score (12.9) reflects the address formula; high substrate score (9.68) reflects the cosmological content.

paragraphs.core_text: So, the cloud shall ascend from fire to the heavens towards the likeness of the Virgin of Light that she shall display to it. Its sign is the flashes that occur with lightning storms [ ... i]ts exchange [ ... ]. And they shall be purified by her towards [ ... ] the light that she shall reveal [ ... ]. The rulers shall be released by the lightning storms and they are freed and sent.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First element: fire. Systematic mapping: element (fire) → cloud type → sign (flashes/lightning) → purification → ruler release. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system. The Virgin of Light functions as a cosmic agent within the process, not as an object of devotion.

paragraphs.core_text: However, [these] angels shall immediately be summoned to them, so that they will seize them, because they know that they shall never do good. Every place they will touch they shall make dead and a loss. Whenever the angels will make towards them and come beside [ ... ], they shall flee in their constraint before them. They go into whatever they will meet upon and assume it, like a robber being abandoned and fleeing before one stronger than him, as he runs after him to arrest him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues fire-cloud teaching: angelic response and ruler behavior. The simile ('like a robber fleeing') is a teaching illustration describing cosmic process, not a contemporary institutional reference. The register scores are all zero but the content is clearly systematic cosmological process.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, those rulers that shall be freed from these clouds and assume whatever they will meet upon [ ... ] into the [ ... / ... ] that they did not [ ... ] will seize this thing, whether indeed a tree to which they have found the way, or animals, or people. Simply, every place that they will assume they shall burn and destroy by the fire of their body. Namely, the rulers, [the] children of fire, they that shall be stripped of the fire.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes fire-cloud sequence. 'Children of fire' is systematic cosmic nomenclature — ruler classification by element. 'Burn and destroy by the fire of their body' maps the rulers' nature (fire-element) to their destructive action. Trees, animals, people are natural-world domains, not institutional references.

paragraphs.core_text: In contrast, [the] cloud that shall be raised up from water, and comes above towards the Virgin of Light; its sign is the thunder storms and the booms that shall come in the atmosphere in various forms and are heard. [ ... ] Again, there are times if the rulers that belong to them, which exist in the cloud, shall on occasion be constrained [in a] water [clou]d. And they flee from it and abandon it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second element: water. Same systematic pattern: element (water) → cloud → sign (thunderstorms/booms) → ruler behavior (constrained, flee). 'In contrast' marks the transition between elements within the teaching structure.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, [they] too are so, in that every place that they will [reach], they shall make frost and hail and snow. [They rui]n the seed-corn and the fruits and the plants; and they [ ... ] every place [that] they will reach.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues water-cloud: water-rulers produce frost, hail, snow — the destructive manifestation corresponds to the water element. Seed-corn, fruits, plants are natural-world targets within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, [ang]els shall be summoned to them who seize them. Still, while the angels [ru]sh after them in order to seize them, they shall make this destruction.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Brief angelic response for water-cloud. Same pattern as fire-cloud (¶4) but compressed. The structural repetition confirms systematic teaching.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, [the cl]oud that will be raised up from wind ascends to the atmosphere between, towards the likeness of the Virgin that she shall display to it. Its sign is [the s]torm wind that shall blow with bitterness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third element: wind. Element (wind) → cloud → sign (storm wind with bitterness). 'Bitterness' is a sensory-quality term within the correspondential system (cf. taste-world mappings in other chapters).

paragraphs.core_text: So, in those winds and tempests shall the lives be purified. Again, the rulers will be stripped of the cloud of wind and they descend from it, safe in their image. All the rivers and the seas that they will reach and arrive at, they shall make waves in them and raise [ ... ] and they [ ... ] the ships. They wreak destruction [ ... ] and they seize and bring them [ ... ].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues wind-cloud: purification of lives, ruler stripping, destructive action (waves, ship destruction). Wind-rulers act upon waters — rivers, seas, ships — describing cosmic process. 'Safe in their image' is a distinctive cosmological term for the rulers' form after stripping.

paragraphs.core_text: Also the cloud, the one of light, immediately they will be stripped of it [ ... / ... ] the Virgin. She shall display its sign too [ ... ]. And its sign is this, in that you shall find it sailing in stillness and calm. The lives in it shall be cleansed in stillness and calm. Again, the rulers that will be stripped of it [ ... ] that will come forth [ ... ] they shall put [ ... ] and they take [ ... / ... ] there [ ... ] the angels seize them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fourth element: light. Sign is 'stillness and calm' — contrasts sharply with the violent signs of fire, water, wind. 'You shall find' is a generic pedagogical voice within the teaching tradition, not editorial address. Extensive lacunae obscure the ruler-destruction portion but the structural pattern is preserved.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, the cloud that shall be raised up from the mingled air comes above towards [the image] of the Virgin. Its sign is this, in that [ ... ] are purified in it in stillness and [rest ... these rulers] that will be stripped of that cloud and come from it; every place that they will find [ ... ] they shall make it [ ... ] one of [ ... ] until [ ... ] they are seized and taken to their midst.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fifth element: mingled air. Completes the five-fold enumeration. Sign involves 'stillness and rest' (similar to light-cloud). Heavy lacunae but structure intact: element → cloud → sign → ruler stripping → seizure. 'Mingled air' is five-element systematic nomenclature.

paragraphs.core_text: Their strippings, that they shall leave behind them in various places they will have reached, whether the produce of the trees or the offspring of the fleshes, they shall be taken midst [ ... ] wither away. They shall inflict great dangers, but again those rulers also the angels shall send to their midst. They bring the light from them and cast the demons down to these seven outer ditches of the great sea; which is the vessel of the waters that are outside the world.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Summary/closure of the five-fold teaching: describes what happens to ruler-strippings, the extraction of light, and the casting of demons into 'seven outer ditches of the great sea.' 'The vessel of the waters that are outside the world' is cosmic geography — the holding structure at the world's boundary. Both sides of every mapping remain within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: To what place do those seven ditches go down?
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'Then his disciples say to him: Instruct us, our master.' — dialogue frame attribution and honorific.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Substantive cosmological question about the location of the seven ditches within cosmic geography. The question defines the supplementary teaching topic (¶15-16). Frame formula is stereotyped; the question itself reveals teaching structure.

paragraphs.core_text: Those ditches and the [ ... ] until they reach the earths below [ ... ] feet of the Porter.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed '[The apostle] says to them:' — dialogue frame attribution.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The Porter (Atlas figure) is a cosmic being in the cosmological architecture. 'Earths below' and 'feet of the Porter' are cosmic geography — the ditches extend down to the foundation structure of the world. Heavy lacunae but the cosmological datum is preserved.

paragraphs.core_text: [ ... ] for sometimes these angels shall be sent to them, to seize the rulers. Whenever the rulers [ ... / ... ] for the angels rush after them. They beseech them [ ... ] they that are given the command. However, [t]hose [rul]ers shall be freed from them alone and assume [ ... ] and [the fle]sh. They are consumed by this offspring [ ... / ... ] tree and that of flesh. The angels shall set a [ ... ] over them, that they might guard them until the hour when [those r]ulers will be stripped of tree and [flesh; a]nd they go up above. They shall be gathered [ ... ] above, and they are poured out [ ... ] in their first for[ms ... im]ages in which they first were. They take the light from them, which had remained behind in them. And they too are cast down to these seven outer [path]s that are in the great sea; the place to where these former ones [were c/as]t. They shall reach their midst [ ... ] and the light that is in them is taken.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'Hear also' — pedagogical address formula at the opening.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Extended teaching on the secondary process: rulers who escape initial seizure, assume flesh/tree, are guarded by angels until stripping, then gathered, light extracted, and cast into the seven outer paths. This elaborates the process beyond the five-fold pattern. 'Poured out in their first forms/images in which they first were' describes the rulers' reversion — systematic cosmic process. Despite heavy lacunae, the teaching sequence is coherent.

paragraphs.core_text: And they are cast to the outer prison by the angels, when the command is given to them through the power of the Virgin of Light. She has authority over the entire zone, and cleanses the life that is in it.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'Behold now, I have instructed you about this cloud: How it shall ascend above, and the lives that are in it are purified. I have also taught you of the rulers that are in it: how they shall make these {rebellions} and how they shall be {caught}.' — first-person recap/dialogue frame summarizing already-delivered teaching.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The seam detection flagged 'Behold now' as editorial but with weak institutional evidence. The recap portion is clearly dialogue frame. However, the final two sentences contain a distinctive cosmological datum: the Virgin of Light's authority over the entire zone. Gardner specifically notes this as significant — this role is elsewhere taken by the Third Ambassador. This is a teaching-level cosmological assertion, not just recap. Extracted the cosmic process statement and the authority declaration.

Formulaic devotional closing: disciples glorify, give thanks, praise the teacher. No cosmological content. 'All the secrets,' 'all revelations,' 'every thing,' 'the knowledge' are generic honorifics. The structure analysis detected 'formulaic closing' for this chapter, confirmed here.
